heroes.headline: Five Houthi missiles shot down over Saudi Arabia

heroes.headline: Magnitude 6.7 earthquake shakes central Peru
heroes.summary: The deep quake near Carhuamayo was felt in Lima and along the coast. Peru's institute reported no deaths, damage or tsunami risk.
